summary: Samos Energy Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K on July 15, 2026, reporting the effectiveness of its IPO registration statement on July 9 and the completion of its IPO on July 13, 2026. The company sold 20 million units at $10.00 each, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one-half warrant exercisable at $11.50/share. The underwriting agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald and standard SPAC trust/warrant agreements were entered into. This is a routine capital-raising event with no special-situation trigger. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special event is present.
